G. 90M-1-39

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.B. REGISTRY
File No 354
SPECIAL BRANCH 61. Sheldon, 40
REPORT
Date: Aug. 30th. 1940

Subject. TRANSLATION FROM THE TAIRIKU SHIMPO, LOCAL JAPANESE DAILY, REGARDING
SIX RUSSIAN MEMBERS OF THE FRENCH V.C. WHO HAD DESERTED A FEW DAYS AGO.

Made by. D.S.I. Maklaevsky Forwarded by. D.S.I. Logan.

With reference to the attached translation from the
" Tairiku Shimpo ", local Japanese daily, of August 28th.
1940 enquiries show that there is no truth, whatsoever ,
in the report regarding six Russian members of the
Auxiliary Detachment of the French Volunteer Corps who
had deserted a few days ago. There is not, likewise, any
truth in the report regarding the theft of the two
machine guns from the French Volunteer Corps.

D.S.I. Maklaevsky -
D.S.I. Maklaevsky -
D.C. (SPECIAL BRANCH).
D.S.I. Maklaevsky

DATE 6 / 9 / 40

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特别处档案室
档案号 354
特别处 61. Sheldon, 40
报告
日期：1940年8月30日

事由：译自当地日文日报《大陆新报》，关于数日前叛逃的六名法籍志愿团（French V.C.）俄籍成员之报道。

编制人：警督马卡耶夫斯基（D.S.I. Maklaevsky） 转呈人：警督洛根（D.S.I. Logan）。

关于随附译自1940年8月28日当地日文日报《大陆新报》之译文，经查询显示，有关法籍志愿团辅助分队（Auxiliary Detachment of the French Volunteer Corps）六名俄籍成员于数日前叛逃的报道，毫无事实依据。同样，有关从法籍志愿团盗窃两挺机枪的报道，亦无事实依据。

警督马卡耶夫斯基 -
